request.style: English, solemn female solo voice with low choir, harp, oboe, cello, timpani, tragic orchestral, 80 BPM
request.lyrics:
[Verse]
Nine hundred iron chariots rolled
Cruel oppression lasted twenty years
Israel cried out to the Lord
Jabin reigned in Hazor with fear
Sisera commanded the army
Harosheth-hagoyim was his home

[Chorus]
He asked for water she gave him milk
In a bowl fit for a prince
Her hand reached for the tent peg
Her right hand for the hammer
She struck Sisera crushed his head
Shattered and pierced his temple

[Verse]
Barak went up Mount Tabor
Sisera summoned his troops
From Kishon River to the battle
The Lord routed his forces
Sisera fled on foot
Left his chariot behind in dust

[Chorus]
He asked for water she gave him milk
In a bowl fit for a prince
Her hand reached for the tent peg
Her right hand for the hammer
She struck Sisera crushed his head
Shattered and pierced his temple

[Bridge]
Jael covered him with a blanket
He lay fast asleep and exhausted
She drove the peg into the ground
So he died in the tent
Barak came and found him there
Dead with the peg through his head

[Outro]
Most blessed of women be Jael
Most blessed of women in tents
Sisera's mother looked out the window
Wailing for the spoil and the cloth
